english.title: Vehicle driver in aircraft accident failed to stop and report accident - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Liverpool John Lennon Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when an accident occurred involving an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the owner of the vehicle, the registration number or identifying marks of the vehicle and details of the accident to a constable, airport official or other person having reasonable grounds for requiring them as soon as reasonably practicable and in any event no later than 24 hours after the accident
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 8(3)(b) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
